summary: Frontend-only smoke and regression test after the fork, at 390x844 on https://arrivewise.preview.emergentagent.com. All 9 requested flows PASS. Landing page renders landing-merchant-sign-in, landing-cta-staff, landing-track-link and landing-cta-merchant. Admin login at /sign-in/staff goes to /admin (Control Center), and /admin/merchants (3 stores), /admin/drivers (3 drivers, PIN SET), /admin/signups (0 waiting) and /admin/setup (all 3 steps done) render without crashes. Driver toggle with (519) 555-0101 / 482913 goes to /driver/drv-1 and shows the R-101 Downtown manifest (6 stops, next-stop card, map). No consent modal appeared because drv-1 had already given consent. Merchant bakery goes to /merchant/mer-1 (counts, CSV import, invoices, statements, billing address, report). Merchant books goes to /merchant/mer-2 with the pharmacy sections (pharmacy-runs with afternoon/evening batch trackers, pharmacy-summary-card). /customer/MD1001 shows ETA, stops away, driver first name and PENDING status, and hides the address while locked. Entering 0100 unlocks it: the address 291 Queen St S appears, plus the driver note and window booking. Sign-up: Pharmacy shows the PIPEDA/PHIPA hint and privacy link and opens consent-modal. Store shows the Terms of Service hint and link and opens terms-modal. No pageerrors and no console errors or warnings in this session's runs. No red screens. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch in package.json). Backend suite not rerun, as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: Observation only: both merchant portals show 0 orders, 0 on the way and 0 delivered, while driver drv-1 has 6 active stops (MD1001 etc.). This is probably expected: the seeded route stops are not tied to mer-1/mer-2 orders, or the counts are date-scoped. Verify only if merchants should see seeded orders.
Observation only: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log contains an old (2026-10-27 13:09) EJSONEMPTY crash for /root/.expo/state.json. The file is valid now and expo is RUNNING, so this is not current.
seed_data_creation: None. The sign-up flow was only opened up to the consent/terms modals and cancelled, so nothing was submitted. The MD1001 unlock is stored on the test browser only.
